stations.title: Athletics (Strength)
stations.setting: A sheer grey limestone cliff face with ledges and cracks, a rope hanging down it.
stations.situation: The only way on is up a sheer cliff face, and he sets his hands to the rock.

stations.title: Acrobatics (Dexterity)
stations.setting: A narrow old rope bridge with plank treads over a deep wooded gorge.
stations.situation: An old rope bridge sways over the gorge, and he steps onto the first plank.

stations.title: Sleight of Hand (Dexterity)
stations.setting: A crowded village market with a fat leather purse hanging loose at a merchant's belt.
stations.situation: A merchant's fat purse hangs loose in the crowd, and he reaches for it.

stations.title: Stealth (Dexterity)
stations.setting: A long shadowed stone corridor lit by one far torch, a sleeping guard at the end.
stations.situation: A guard dozes at the end of a dark corridor, and he creeps along the wall.

stations.title: Arcana (Intelligence)
stations.setting: A sealed stone door cut with old carved ward marks in a cellar of dry rock.
stations.situation: A sealed door is cut with old ward marks, and he tries to make sense of them.

stations.title: History (Intelligence)
stations.setting: A weathered carved stone stele standing in a field of long grass.
stations.situation: A worn carved stone stands in the grass, and he tries to recall who raised it.

stations.title: Investigation (Intelligence)
stations.setting: A cluttered scholar's study of papers, a locked chest and a half-open drawer.
stations.situation: A scholar's study lies in disorder, and he searches it for what matters.

stations.title: Nature (Intelligence)
stations.setting: A quiet forest glade with a trodden animal track and an odd cluster of mushrooms.
stations.situation: Fresh tracks and an odd growth mark the glade, and he tries to read what passed here.

stations.title: Religion (Intelligence)
stations.setting: A small wayside shrine of weathered stone with offerings of wilted flowers and bread.
stations.situation: A small shrine stands at the crossroads, and he tries to recall whose it is and what it asks.

stations.title: Animal Handling (Wisdom)
stations.setting: A skittish carthorse rearing slightly in a farmyard, eyes wide.
stations.situation: A frightened carthorse rears in the yard, and he steps close to calm it.

stations.title: Insight (Wisdom)
stations.setting: A wary merchant behind a stall, arms folded, eyeing a customer.
stations.situation: A merchant swears his goods are honest, and he studies the man's face.

stations.title: Medicine (Wisdom)
stations.setting: A wounded traveller sitting against a milestone, a bloody bandage on one arm.
stations.situation: A wounded traveller sits against a milestone, and he kneels to tend the wound.

stations.title: Perception (Wisdom)
stations.setting: A stone watchtower on a ridge overlooking a wide valley with something moving far off.
stations.situation: From the watchtower he scans the valley for anything that moves.

stations.title: Survival (Wisdom)
stations.setting: A faint wilderness trail through rough moorland with old tracks and a cold fire ring.
stations.situation: The trail fades into the moor, and he reads the ground for the way.

stations.title: Deception (Charisma)
stations.setting: A stern gate guard at a town gate, spear in hand, blocking the way.
stations.situation: A guard bars the gate, and he spins a story to get past him.

stations.title: Intimidation (Charisma)
stations.setting: A bandit with a cudgel at a river ford, wary and half-afraid.
stations.situation: A bandit blocks the ford, and he squares up to make him think twice.

stations.title: Performance (Charisma)
stations.setting: A tavern's low plank stage with a stool and an audience of a few seated villagers.
stations.situation: The tavern wants a song or a tale, and he steps onto the stage.

stations.title: Persuasion (Charisma)
stations.setting: A village elder seated on a bench before a thatched cottage, hands folded.
stations.situation: The village elder will not be hurried, and he makes his honest case.

stations.title: Strength check
stations.setting: A heavy iron portcullis stuck half-raised in a stone gateway.
stations.situation: A rusted portcullis jams the gateway half raised, and he heaves at the bars.

stations.title: Dexterity check
stations.setting: A narrow old rope bridge with plank treads over a deep wooded gorge.
stations.situation: The bridge planks tilt underfoot, and he must keep his feet on pure balance.

stations.title: Constitution check
stations.setting: A long steep road up a bare hill at dusk, a weary traveller on the climb.
stations.situation: The long climb goes on into dusk, and he grinds out one more mile.

stations.title: Intelligence check
stations.setting: A cluttered scholar's study of papers, a locked chest and a half-open drawer.
stations.situation: A puzzle of papers and clues lies on the scholar's table, and he works it through.

stations.title: Wisdom check
stations.setting: A stone watchtower on a ridge overlooking a wide valley with something moving far off.
stations.situation: Something about the valley feels wrong, and he trusts his sense of it.

stations.title: Charisma check
stations.setting: A village elder seated on a bench before a thatched cottage, hands folded.
stations.situation: The room is waiting on him, and he leans on the plain force of his presence.

stations.title: Passive Perception
stations.setting: A stone watchtower on a ridge overlooking a wide valley with something moving far off.
stations.situation: As he stands the watch, the question is whether he notices the thing nobody points out.

stations.title: Strength saving throw
stations.setting: A narrow gully with a wall of flood water rushing down it.
stations.situation: A wall of flood water comes down the gully, and he braces against it.

stations.title: Dexterity saving throw
stations.setting: A stone corridor with a blade swinging out of the wall at chest height.
stations.situation: A blade swings out of the corridor wall, and he throws himself aside.

stations.title: Constitution saving throw
stations.setting: A foul marshy cave mouth breathing out a thick yellow-green fume.
stations.situation: A foul fume rolls out of the cave, and he holds his breath against it.

stations.title: Intelligence saving throw
stations.setting: A bare round chamber with a single carved stone face set in the wall, whispering.
stations.situation: A great stone face whispers into his mind, and he fights to keep it clear.

stations.title: Wisdom saving throw
stations.setting: A foggy old graveyard with a pale hooded figure standing between the stones.
stations.situation: A pale figure stands among the graves, and he steels himself against the dread.

stations.title: Charisma saving throw
stations.setting: A ring of old standing stones in fog on a moor, the air heavy and strange.
stations.situation: The old stones press on his will, and he holds on to himself.

stations.title: Melee attack roll (longsword)
stations.setting: A castle training yard with a straw dummy, a weapon rack and a sand floor.
stations.situation: He sets his feet before the dummy and swings the longsword.

stations.title: Ranged attack roll (longbow)
stations.setting: An archery range with a straw target at the end of a meadow.
stations.situation: He draws the longbow on the distant target and looses.

stations.title: Athletics contested by Athletics
stations.setting: A burly dockhand and the warrior locked in a shoving contest on a quayside.
stations.situation: A dockhand will not give way, and they grapple on the quay to see who is stronger.

stations.title: Initiative (Dexterity)
stations.setting: A forest road with something stirring in the trees on both sides.
stations.situation: Something stirs in the trees on both sides of the road, and he reacts first or last.

stations.title: Death saving throw
stations.setting: A bleak battlefield at dusk with a fallen man lying among broken spears.
stations.situation: He lies fallen on the field at dusk, and the fight to stay alive is decided on one die.

stations.title: Damage dice
stations.setting: A castle training yard with a straw dummy, a weapon rack and a sand floor.
stations.situation: He strikes true, and the dice say how hard.

stations.title: Second Wind and healing dice
stations.setting: A quiet campfire in a woodland clearing with a bedroll and a water flask.
stations.situation: He catches his breath by the fire, and the dice say how much he recovers.

stations.title: Percentile table roll (d100)
stations.setting: A treasure vault with a stone table, chests and a modest heap of coins.
stations.situation: The vault holds more than he can carry, and a percentile roll decides what is in reach.
